headlines.title: 三部门：调整部分电池消费税政策
headlines.summary: 财政部等三部门发布关于调整部分电池消费税政策的公告。为进一步完善消费税制度，现将电池消费税政策调整事项公告如下： 一、自2026年9月1日起，对无汞原电池、金属氢化物镍蓄电池（又称氢镍蓄电池或镍氢蓄电池）、锂原电池、锂离子蓄电池、全钒液流电池按照2%税率征收消费税；自2027年9月1日起，对上述电池产品按照4%税率征收消费税。

headlines.title_en: Three ministries adjust tax policy on certain batteries
headlines.summary_en: The Ministry of Finance and two other departments issued a notice adjusting the consumption tax policy on certain batteries. To further refine the consumption tax system, the battery consumption tax policy adjustments are announced as follows: 1. From September 1, 2026, mercury-free primary batteries, nickel-metal hydride batteries, lithium primary batteries, lithium-ion batteries, and all-vanadium redox flow batteries shall be taxed at a rate of 2%; from September 1, 2027, these battery products shall be taxed at a rate of 4%.

headlines.title: SHEIN据报获联交所批准IPO 最快8月底赴港上市
headlines.summary: 路透引述消息称，中国跨境快时尚巨头希音(SHEIN)已获联交所上市委员会批准进行IPO，并计划于本月27日发布可供公众查阅的上市文件，最快8月底上市。 知情人士透露，希音已开始安排与投资者的营销会议，目标估值约400亿-500亿美元(约3120亿-3920亿港元)，集资额料约20亿-30亿美元(约156亿-234亿港元)。此外，据中国证监会上周五通知显示，希音已获准发行不超过3.41亿股境外上市普通股，并在港交所上市。 希音此次IPO将成为香港近年最受关注的上市案例之一，也是对投资者对大型消费类企业发股的重大考验。

headlines.title_en: SHEIN reportedly receives HKEX approval for IPO, may list in Hong Kong by end of August
headlines.summary_en: Reuters cited sources saying that Chinese cross-border fast-fashion giant SHEIN has received approval from the Hong Kong Stock Exchange listing committee for its IPO, plans to publish a publicly available listing document on the 27th of this month, and aims to list by the end of August at the earliest. Insiders revealed that SHEIN has begun arranging marketing meetings with investors, with a target valuation of approximately $40-50 billion and expected fundraising of about $2-3 billion. Additionally, according to a notice from the CSRC last Friday, SHEIN has been approved to issue no more than 341 million overseas-listed ordinary shares and list on the HKEX. This IPO will be one of the most anticipated listings in Hong Kong in recent years and a major test of investor appetite for large consumer-focused companies.

headlines.title: 中共中央政治局常委、全国政协主席王沪宁对朝鲜进行正式友好访问
headlines.summary: 应朝鲜劳动党中央委员会和朝鲜民主主义人民共和国政府邀请，中共中央政治局常委、全国政协主席王沪宁于7月15日至17日率中国党政代表团对朝鲜进行正式友好访问，在平壤会见朝鲜劳动党总书记、国务委员长金正恩，同朝鲜劳动党中央政治局常委、国务委员会副委员长、内阁总理朴泰成共同出席《中朝友好合作互助条约》签订65周年纪念招待会，同朝鲜劳动党中央政治局常委、中央书记、组织指导部部长赵甬元举行会谈。(新华社)

headlines.title_en: Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and chairman of the CPPCC National Committee, makes an official goodwill visit to North Korea
headlines.summary_en: At the invitation of the Central Committee of the Workers' Party of Korea and the Government of the Democratic People's Republic of Korea, Wang Huning, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Chairman of the National Committee of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, led a Chinese Party and government delegation on an official goodwill visit to the DPRK from July 15 to 17. He met with Kim Jong Un, General Secretary of the Workers' Party of Korea and President of the State Affairs Commission, in Pyongyang; jointly attended a reception commemorating the 65th anniversary of the signing of the China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance with Pak Thae Song, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, Vice President of the State Affairs Commission, and Premier of the Cabinet; and held talks with Jo Yong Won, member of the Presidium of the Political Bureau of the WPK Central Committee, Secretary of the Central Committee, and Director of the Organization and Guidance Department. (Xinhua)

headlines.title: 今晚油价上调 加满一箱92号汽油多花12元
headlines.summary: 从国家发展改革委获悉，今日24时国内成品油调价窗口将开启。据国家发展改革委价格监测中心监测，本轮成品油调价周期内（7月3日24时——7月17日24时），国际油价震荡上涨。 7月17日24时起，国内汽、柴油零售限价每吨分别上调300元和290元。全国平均来看，92号汽油、95号汽油和0号柴油每升分别上调0.24元、0.25元、0.25元。(央视新闻)

headlines.title_en: Oil prices to rise tonight; filling a 92-octane tank costs 12 yuan more
headlines.summary_en: Learned from the NDRC that the window for adjusting domestic refined oil product prices will open at 24:00 today. According to monitoring by the Price Monitoring Center of the NDRC, international oil prices rose with fluctuations during this adjustment cycle (from 24:00 on July 3 to 24:00 on July 17). From 24:00 on July 17, domestic retail price caps for gasoline and diesel will be raised by RMB 300 and RMB 290 per ton, respectively. Nationwide average, 92 RON gasoline, 95 RON gasoline, and 0 diesel will increase by RMB 0.24, RMB 0.25, and RMB 0.25 per liter, respectively. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 中国证监会组织财务造假综合惩防跨部门培训
headlines.summary: 【中国证监会组织财务造假综合惩防跨部门培训】中国证监会在京组织综合惩防体系跨部门业务培训，相关部门和证监会系统200多名同志参加。这是相关部门深入贯彻落实党中央国务院关于打击防范资本市场财务造假重大决策部署的重要工作举措。培训期间，来自证券监管、公安司法、宣传网信等领域的业务专家围绕提高综合惩防工作的系统性、整体性和协同性，构建更加严密的监管发现网络，发挥行政刑事民事全方位立体式追责提高违法成本，加强跨部门协作提高监管执法效率效果进行了讲解研讨，以提升监管执法人员综合实战能力。

headlines.title_en: A-share close: ChiNext Index drops over 7%, nearly 200 stocks limit down across the market
headlines.summary_en: The market opened low and moved lower throughout the day, with the three major indices declining sharply on increased volume. Power stocks bucked the trend to strengthen, with Guiguan Electric Power, Leshan Electric Power, and Huayin Electric Power hitting the daily limit up. Financial stocks staged an intraday rally, with Xiangcai Securities hitting the daily limit up. On the downside, semiconductor chip stocks plunged sharply, with multiple stocks like GigaDevice, Demone Group, and Tongfu Microelectronics hitting the daily limit down; computing hardware stocks collectively fell, with TFC Optical Communication, Zhongji Innolight, and Eoptolink Technology all falling over 10%. Individual stocks experienced widespread declines, with nearly 5,000 stocks in the Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing stock markets turning red. Today's total turnover was RMB 2.67 trillion. By the close, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 3.05%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 5.4%, and the ChiNext Index fell 7.15%.

headlines.title: China’s second-quarter GDP growth misses mark, with lowest reading since end of 2022
headlines.summary:
China reported 4.3 per cent gross domestic product growth in the second quarter of 2026 shortly after recording strong, sustained momentum in exports – a contrast underscoring the need for policy support to address weak domestic demand and persistent economic imbalances.
The closely watched GDP figure, released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Wednesday, was the slowest quarterly growth rate since the end of 2022. The number fell below the 4.48 per cent forecast from economists...

headlines.title_en: Monthly active users of securities apps exceeded 186 million in June, up over 15% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: According to the latest data from Analysys Qianfan, the monthly active user (MAU) scale of securities apps in June 2026 reached 186 million, up 1.78% month-on-month and 15.08% year-on-year. Specifically, among third-party service apps, Tongdaxin, East Money, and Dazhihui ranked in the top three, with MAU of 38.5257 million, 19.1762 million, and 13.7466 million, respectively. For broker-owned apps, Huatai Securities' Zhang Le Fortune, Guotai Haitong Jun Hong, and Ping An Securities ranked among the top, with Zhang Le Fortune leading with an MAU of 12.8353 million. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title: 业内人士：当前A股市场调整更多是慢牛中的高波动，市场当前位置具备较强支撑
headlines.summary: 7月17日午后，上证指数盘中失守3800点，创业板、深证成指一度跌超8%。随后，三大指数触底回升，创业板指跌幅迅速收窄至4%左右。业内人士分析，当前调整更多是慢牛过程中的一次高波动，而不是趋势性拐点。尤其在上证指数回到年线附近、两融杠杆已有一定去化、科创50、创业板指、中证1000等成长类ETF仍有资金流入的背景下，市场当前位置具备较强支撑。（新京报）

headlines.title_en: Insiders: Current A-share market adjustments are more about high volatility within a slow bull market, with strong support at current levels
headlines.summary_en: On the afternoon of July 17, the Shanghai Composite Index briefly fell below the 3800-point mark during trading, while the ChiNext and Shenzhen Component indices once dropped over 8%. Subsequently, the three major indices rebounded from their lows, with the ChiNext Index's decline quickly narrowing to around 4%. Industry analysts suggest that the current adjustment is more of a high-volatility phase within a gradual bull market rather than a trend reversal. Especially with the Shanghai Composite Index returning near its annual moving average, some deleveraging in margin trading, and continued capital inflows into growth-oriented ETFs such as the STAR 50, ChiNext Index, and CSI 1000, the market's current level is well-supported. (Beijing News)
